mike: PR #234 ready for review — added a short section called 'model routing tie-breaker' that explains what happens when two model variants have equal routing weight. Need runtime confirmation before merge. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/234

anya: quick glance looks fine. one blocking Q: the doc says 'deterministic selection' — what's the exact algorithm if two variants are equal? also what header do we hash on? cc @kevin :eyes:

kevin: short answer: runtime uses a stable hash on the request id (we use the Idempotency-Key / request_id header if present). if that header is missing we fall back to a per-node round-robin which is not globally deterministic. config key we expose is `routing.selection_strategy = "hash_with_rr_fallback"`.

mike: can you confirm that's the exact config key/value we should put in docs? i used 'stable-hash' in the draft text which might be too vague.

kevin: confirm — please use the exact string `hash_with_rr_fallback`. also note: `routing.pin_model_version = true` will bypass selection and pin to the provided variant if set.

jessica: heads up CI/docs preview failed linkcheck on this branch — looks like an internal runtime link we pointed to is 404 so the preview flagged it.

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck failed: /internal/runtime/routing.md (404) — see full report in the preview job.

anya: ok, we'll remove the internal link and instead link to the public runtime RFC or a short runtime docs blurb. @kevin can you either add a public anchor or confirm wording we can link to?

kevin: i'll add a short public section in runtime docs (public) by EOD. in the meantime you can document it verbatim as: `routing.selection_strategy = "hash_with_rr_fallback"` and note that the selection hashes the `Idempotency-Key` header, falling back to round-robin if missing.

mike: good — backup plan is to keep the wording generic: "uses stable hashing on request id header (Idempotency-Key) with round-robin fallback" and mark the PR as awaiting runtime confirmation. holding merge until kevin posts the runtime doc. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: agreed, putting merge hold.

kevin: pushed runtime docs change: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — should be public in ~10m, will update here once merged.

mike: ack. i'll re-run docs preview after that merge and then merge PR if everything passes. thanks all! :tada:
